meta.title: काय समाविष्ट आहे
meta.description: आयुर्वेदिक उत्पादनासाठी कोणते बौद्धिक संपदा आणि नियामक प्रश्न लागू होतात आणि ते कसे जोडले जातात.

heading: आयुर्वेदाचे बौद्धिक संपदा आणि नियामक वातावरण समजून घेणे
standfirst: आयुर्वेदिक उत्पादनाचे वेगवेगळे भाग वेगवेगळे प्रश्न निर्माण करतात.

pending.title: या पृष्ठावरील काहीही अद्याप स्रोतातून घेतलेले नाही
pending.body: कोणतेही दस्तऐवज समाविष्ट केलेले नाहीत, म्हणून खालील प्रत्येक विधान प्रलंबित म्हणून चिन्हांकित आहे.

distinction.heading: दोन प्रश्न आणि ते का जोडलेले आहेत
distinction.ipBody: मी यामध्ये हक्क कसे सुरक्षित करू किंवा समजू? हे अनन्यतेबद्दल आहे.
distinction.regBody: हे बनवण्यापूर्वी, विकण्यापूर्वी किंवा जाहिरात करण्यापूर्वी मी काय केले पाहिजे? हे परवानगीबद्दल आहे.
distinction.couplingHeading: आयुर्वेदासाठी, हे दोनदा विचारलेला एकच प्रश्न आहे
distinction.couplingBody: बहुतेक उद्योग यांना स्वतंत्र मानू शकतात. येथे तसे करता येत नाही कारण नियामक वर्गीकरण बौद्धिक संपदा ठरवते.
distinction.matrixHeading: प्रत्येक उत्पादन वर्ग काय सुरू करतो आणि काय थांबवतो

classical_generic.ip: रचना दस्तऐवजीकरण केलेले पारंपरिक ज्ञान आहे, त्यामुळे दावा करता येत नाही. ब्रँड, पॅकेजिंग उपलब्ध आहेत.
classical_generic.regulatory: [MR] The classical route, resting on the authoritative texts the drug rules recognise.
classical_generic.abs: [MR] Duties can still attach to the biological resource used, whatever the formulation's status.

patent_proprietary.ip: प्रत्यक्षात काय बदलले यावर युक्तिवाद करता येतो. पारंपरिक आधार उर्वरित भागासाठी पूर्व कला मानला जातो.
patent_proprietary.regulatory: [MR] Licensed as a patent or proprietary medicine, with conditions of its own.
patent_proprietary.abs: [MR] Duties attach, and they begin to interact with anything you file.

new_non_classical_drug.ip: सर्वात मोठी संधी. नवीन प्रक्रिया किंवा पूर्वी अज्ञात असलेल्या संयोजनावर त्याच्या गुणवत्तेनुसार दावा केला जाऊ शकतो.
new_non_classical_drug.regulatory: [MR] The new-drug route, which asks for evidence rather than textual authority.
new_non_classical_drug.abs: [MR] Duties attach, and disclosure of the biological source becomes part of the filing.

phytopharmaceutical.ip: शुद्ध किंवा प्रमाणित अर्क हे सर्वाधिक पेटंट करण्यायोग्य रूप आहे, कारण ते संपूर्ण वनस्पती रचनेपासून सर्वात दूर आहे.
phytopharmaceutical.regulatory: [MR] A route of its own, with data requirements separate from both the classical and the new-drug paths.
phytopharmaceutical.abs: [MR] Duties attach; the resource is usually a named plant, which makes the trigger easy to identify and hard to avoid.

ayurveda_aahar.ip: [MR] Brand, packaging and design. A food cannot be claimed as a medicine, and the composition is rarely claimable.
ayurveda_aahar.regulatory: [MR] The food route, under the food authority rather than the drug regulator.
ayurveda_aahar.abs: [MR] Duties can attach to the resource. Being a food does not remove them.

cosmetic.ip: [MR] Brand, packaging and the design of the article. Composition claims are narrow.
cosmetic.regulatory: [MR] The cosmetic route, which turns on external use for appearance rather than therapeutic effect.
cosmetic.abs: [MR] Duties can attach to the resource, on the same basis as any other use.

rights.heading: हक्क, एका वेळी एक
rights.standfirst: यापैकी प्रत्येक वेगवेगळ्या प्रश्नाचे उत्तर देतो.

labels.inAyurveda: How it shows up in Ayurveda
labels.question: A question people actually ask

patents.title: पेटंट
patents.protects: (पेटंट) A new invention that is not obvious to someone skilled in the field, for a limited term, in exchange for disclosing how it works.
patents.inAyurveda: Rarely the formulation itself. More often a process, a delivery form, a purified fraction, or a specific combination that does something the individual ingredients were not already known to do.
patents.question: We reformulated a classical preparation — is there anything patentable in it?
patents.doesNot: It does not give you permission to sell: a granted patent and a manufacturing licence are separate and neither implies the other. It does not make a formulation new — documented traditional knowledge is prior art, and an aggregation of known properties is generally not an invention.
patents.jurisdiction: India, with separate filings in every other country you want protection in.

gi.title: भौगोलिक संकेत
gi.protects: (भौगोलिक संकेत) A name identifying goods as coming from a particular place, where a quality, reputation or characteristic is due to that origin.
gi.inAyurveda: Regional herbs and preparations whose character is tied to where they grow, or to how a locality has long made them.
gi.question: Our herb grows only in one district — does that qualify for a geographical indication?
gi.doesNot: It is not owned by one company. A GI is held for a class of producers meeting the specification, so it gives no exclusivity over competitors in the same region, and does not stop anyone outside it making a similar product under another name.
gi.jurisdiction: India. Protection elsewhere is separate and works differently from country to country.

trademarks.title: ट्रेडमार्क
trademarks.protects: (ट्रेडमार्क) A sign that tells a buyer who made the product.
trademarks.inAyurveda: Brand names for Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani products, house marks, and the get-up of a pack.
trademarks.question: Can we register our brand name if it contains a classical formulation name?
trademarks.doesNot: It does not hand you a classical formulation name. A mark merely describing the product will struggle, and other manufacturers need the same classical name for the same preparation. Registration does not license a claim the advertising rules prohibit — mark and claim are judged separately.
trademarks.jurisdiction: India, with separate registration abroad or through an international filing system.

copyright.title: कॉपीराइट
copyright.protects: (कॉपीराइट) Original expression — text, images, artwork, software — not the ideas, facts or methods inside it.
copyright.inAyurveda: Course material, translations and commentaries, packaging artwork, photography, software. The classical texts are long out of copyright; a new translation or commentary is a new work with its own term.
copyright.question: Can we stop someone copying our training material?
copyright.doesNot: It does not protect a formulation, a process, or a treatment protocol. Someone may read your book and make your product.
copyright.jurisdiction: India, with protection in most other countries arising automatically under treaty rather than by registration.

designs.title: डिझाइन
designs.protects: (डिझाइन) How a manufactured article looks — its shape, configuration, pattern or ornament.
designs.inAyurveda: A bottle, a dispenser, a jar closure, the form of a pack.
designs.question: We designed a distinctive dispenser — can we protect the shape?
designs.doesNot: It does not protect how the article works, and it does not survive publication: showing the design before you apply can destroy the right you were about to register.
designs.jurisdiction: India, with separate filings or an international route abroad.

plantVariety.title: वनस्पती वाण हक्क
plantVariety.protects: (वनस्पती वाण हक्क) A new plant variety that is distinct from what exists, uniform within itself, and stable across generations.
plantVariety.inAyurveda: Cultivated varieties of medicinal plants developed for yield, potency, or hardiness.
plantVariety.question: We developed a cultivar of a medicinal plant — can we register it?
plantVariety.doesNot: It is not a patent on the plant, and it sits alongside farmers' rights rather than overriding them.
plantVariety.jurisdiction: India, under a regime of its own rather than under the patent system.

tradeSecrets.title: व्यापार गुपिते
tradeSecrets.protects: (व्यापार गुपिते) In India, no standalone statute. Confidential information is held through contract, employment terms and the general law rather than by any registration.
tradeSecrets.inAyurveda: Process know-how, sourcing relationships, standardisation methods — precisely the things a patent application would have to disclose.
tradeSecrets.question: Should we file a patent or keep the process confidential?
tradeSecrets.doesNot: It gives you nothing against independent discovery or reverse engineering, and it is in direct tension with two disclosure obligations: what a patent application must reveal, and what a regulatory dossier must contain.
tradeSecrets.jurisdiction: India — and the absence of a dedicated statute is itself the point, so this section states a gap rather than a regime.

tk.title: पारंपरिक ज्ञान
tk.protects: (पारंपरिक ज्ञान) It depends on whether the knowledge is codified in published texts or held by a community. These are different problems with different answers.
tk.inAyurveda: Codified knowledge in the authoritative texts is why many formulation patents fail: it is prior art, documented so it can be cited as such. Community-held knowledge raises a different question, about consent and about sharing what comes of it.
tk.question: Our formulation comes from a community's practice — what do we owe them?
tk.doesNot: Defensive protection stops others patenting what is already known. It gives you no exclusive right of your own, and does not substitute for the access and benefit-sharing duties below.
tk.jurisdiction: India, and internationally: a 2024 treaty addresses intellectual property, genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge, including what an applicant must disclose.

classification.title: उत्पादन वर्गीकरण
classification.body: [उत्पादन वर्गीकरण] Everything downstream follows from what your product is: a classical preparation, a patent or proprietary medicine, a new non-classical drug, a phytopharmaceutical, a food, or a cosmetic. The classification is not a label you choose — it follows from the formulation, the claim you make, and how far you have moved from an authoritative text.
classification.watchFor: Businesses often decide their route first and describe the product to fit. That is the wrong way round, and it is expensive to unwind.

licence.title: उत्पादन परवाना
licence.body: [उत्पादन परवाना] Making an Ayurvedic drug for sale requires a licence from the state licensing authority, and the licence is specific to what you make and where you make it.
licence.watchFor: A licence covering classical preparations does not automatically cover a proprietary medicine. Changing the formulation can put you outside the licence you already hold.

gmp.title: उत्पादन पद्धती (GMP)
gmp.body: [उत्पादन पद्धती (GMP)] Good manufacturing practice requirements for these products cover premises, equipment, staff, water, in-process checks and record-keeping. They are a condition of the licence rather than an optional standard.
gmp.watchFor: Contract manufacturing does not transfer the obligation away from the brand owner.

quality.title: गुणवत्ता आणि फार्माकोपिया मानके
quality.body: [गुणवत्ता आणि फार्माकोपिया मानके] Published pharmacopoeial monographs set identity, purity and strength standards for many single drugs and formulations, and a formulary records recognised preparations.
quality.watchFor: Where a monograph exists, meeting it is the baseline, not a marketing claim. Where none exists, you must be able to say what standard you work to and why.

labelling.title: लेबलिंग
labelling.body: [लेबलिंग] What must appear on the pack is set by more than one regime at once: drug rules, packaged-commodity rules, and — if the product is a food — the food authority's labelling regulations.
labelling.watchFor: The regimes overlap rather than nest. Satisfying one does not mean you have satisfied another.

advertising.title: जाहिरात आणि दावे
advertising.body: [जाहिरात आणि दावे] Advertising of these products is restricted, and certain disease claims are prohibited outright rather than merely regulated. The restriction applies to the advertisement, not only to the label.
advertising.watchFor: A claim that is prohibited on a pack is generally prohibited in a social media post as well. Enforcement follows the claim, not the medium.

food.title: अन्न आणि न्यूट्रास्युटिकल मार्ग
food.body: [अन्न आणि न्यूट्रास्युटिकल मार्ग] A product intended as a food or supplement rather than a medicine falls under the food authority, which has its own category for Ayurveda-derived foods, its own approval process, and its own limits on what a claim may say.
food.watchFor: This route is often chosen to avoid drug licensing. It brings different obligations rather than fewer, and it narrows what you may claim the product does.

cosmetic.title: सौंदर्यप्रसाधने मार्ग
cosmetic.body: [सौंदर्यप्रसाधने मार्ग] A preparation applied externally for appearance rather than therapeutic effect is regulated as a cosmetic, with its own registration and labelling requirements.
cosmetic.watchFor: The boundary is the claim. The same cream is a cosmetic or a drug depending on what you say it does.

clinicalEvidence.title: नवीन औषधासाठी पुरावे
clinicalEvidence.body: [नवीन औषधासाठी पुरावे] A formulation outside the classical texts, or one making a new therapeutic claim, moves into territory where safety and effectiveness have to be shown rather than inferred from tradition.
clinicalEvidence.watchFor: Traditional use can support some routes and not others. Which one you are on decides whether it counts.

marketAccess.title: आयात, निर्यात आणि बाजारपेठ प्रवेश
marketAccess.body: [आयात, निर्यात आणि बाजारपेठ प्रवेश] An Indian licence carries no weight abroad. Each destination decides for itself whether your product is a medicine, a supplement, a food or a novel ingredient, and answers that question by its own rules.
marketAccess.watchFor: The most common surprise is that the product changes category at the border, and with it the entire compliance burden.

abs.heading: प्रवेश आणि लाभ वाटणी
abs.standfirst: ही अशी जबाबदारी आहे जी सहसा उशिरा समजते.
abs.whoBody: तुम्ही कोण आहात यावर जबाबदाऱ्या अवलंबून असतात. भारतीय व्यक्ती, कंपन्या, परदेशी संस्था आणि संशोधक यांच्यासाठी स्वतंत्र नियम आहेत.
abs.triggerBody: संशोधन किंवा व्यावसायिक वापरासाठी जैविक संसाधन किंवा संबंधित पारंपरिक ज्ञानाचा वापर करणे हे कारण ठरते.
abs.authorityBody: राष्ट्रीय जैवविविधता प्राधिकरण (NBA) आणि राज्य जैवविविधता मंडळे (SBB) आहेत.
abs.sharingBody: लाभ वाटणी नेहमी केवळ रोख रक्कम नसते; हे तंत्रज्ञान हस्तांतरण किंवा स्थानिक रोजगार स्वरूपात असू शकते.
abs.patentHeading: हे पेटंट अर्जाशी कसे जोडले जाते
abs.patentBody: जैविक संसाधनावर आधारित पेटंट अर्जात स्रोताचा खुलासा करणे कायदेशीररीत्या बंधनकारक आहे.
abs.changeBody: भारतीय जैवविविधता कायद्यात अलीकडच्या वर्षांत दुरुस्त्या करण्यात आल्या आहेत.
abs.asOfNote: हा कॉर्पस आवृत्ती {{version}} वर आहे. कृपया अधिकृत राजपत्राशी पडताळणी करा.
